title: Evaluating Gender Bias in Large Language Models via Chain-of-Thought Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in prediction accuracy when LLMs are asked to count feminine or masculine words in lists containing only gender-definitive words versus lists that also include stereotypically gendered occupational words (the Multi-step Gender Bias Reasoning benchmark). It also compares these results against existing bias benchmarks such as BBQ, BNLI, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet.
